mapper.sql: SELECT w.*, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, r.nick_name AS reporter_name, h.nick_name AS handler_name FROM eq_work_order w JOIN eq_equipment e ON e.equipment_id = w.equipment_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.user_id = w.reporter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.user_id = w.handler_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eq_work_order WHERE work_order_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM eq_work_order w WHERE w.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND w.status IN ('WAITING','PROCESSING','PENDING_REVIEW')
SELECT * FROM eq_work_order_record WHERE work_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY create_time,record_id
mapper.sql: u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_key='eq_maintainer' AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name FROM sys_user u WHERE AND (u.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.nick_name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY u.user_id
SELECT u.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{id} AND FOR UPDATE
